primitives.sufficient_for: offline verification of binary A/R controls, S ordering controls, and per-image C1 contrasts

bootstrap.method: crossed paired bootstrap: resample training seeds, then draw one shared canonical-image multiset and apply it to every selected seed/control

S_measurement_ordering_gate.synthetic_ECE_role: numeric diagnostic only; no directional claim

interpretation_boundaries.A_R: Sensitivity to severe frozen target-association destruction, not ontology, correctness, grounding, or faithfulness validity.
interpretation_boundaries.S: Ordering behavior and, separately, informativeness relative to one fixed random reference; not a safety guarantee.
interpretation_boundaries.C1: Sensitivity to correct versus destroyed sample correspondence; wrong pairing is not perturbation severity.
interpretation_boundaries.all: BDD-OIA internal evidence for this frozen five-seed protocol only; no CEG, causal, architecture, dataset, or real-world external validity.
